caption: The drawing shows a ceramic cup depicted twice: once from the side (side view, left) and once from the front (face view, right). The cup is a brownish-orange color with visible slip decoration in lighter yellow and greenish tones, forming irregular spots and circular patterns on its surface. The cup has a rounded body with a slightly flared, uneven rim, and a single, rounded handle attached to the side, visible only in the side view. The surface of the cup is textured and shows signs of wear, including chips and darkened patches, particularly around the rim and base. Both representations are placed on a flat, wooden surface, illustrated with brown and gray lines to indicate wood grain. The titles "CUP WITH SLIP DECORATION EARLY EIGHTEEN HUNDRED" and "SIDE VIEW" and "FACE VIEW" are written above and below the images in uppercase letters. The background is an off-white or beige color, with no other objects present.
title: Cup with Slip Decoration
